purpose: Educational guided singing practice; not clinical therapy, diagnosis or proof of efficacy.

stopRule.es: Detente ante dolor, mareo, dificultad para respirar, empeoramiento de ronquera o esfuerzo creciente. No persigas récords de duración ni volumen.
stopRule.en: Stop for pain, dizziness, breathing difficulty, worsening hoarseness or increasing effort. Never chase maximum duration or volume.
stopRule.medical: If dysphonia persists or red flags appear, consult an ENT/voice specialist; urgent breathing symptoms require urgent care.

BREATH19.population: mixed voice-disorder populations; not universal for healthy singers

exercises.goal: Observe natural inhalation and exhalation without forcing an app pace.
stepsEs: Observa el movimiento de las costillas bajas, sin empujar el abdomen.
Inspira y espira con comodidad. El ritmo visual 4–0–6 es opcional.
Interrumpe el ritmo visual si resulta incómodo.
stepsEn: Observe low-rib motion without pushing the abdomen.
Breathe in and out comfortably; the 4–0–6 visual is optional.
Disregard the visual rhythm if uncomfortable.
exercises.transferEs: Tras descansar, canta una frase corta sin forzar.
exercises.assessment: Self-rated comfort only; the screen does not sense rib motion.

exercises.goal: Explore ease of phonation then immediately test an open vowel.
stepsEs: Fonación suave y cómoda a través de una cañita común y limpia.
Haz un deslizamiento pequeño sin aumentar presión.
Retírala y canta /u/ y /a/ a la misma altura, cómodamente.
stepsEn: Phonate softly through a regular clean drinking straw.
Try a small glide without increasing pressure.
Remove it and sing /u/ and /a/ at the same comfortable pitch.
exercises.transferEs: Compara una frase de la canción antes y después, sin prometer mejora.
exercises.assessment: Ease rating and teacher listening; mic pitch is not pressure.
exercises.fallback: Use lip trills only if comfortable; recording optional.

exercises.goal: Transfer comfortable humming into intelligible sung text.
stepsEs: Tararea /m/ muy suave en nota cómoda.
Abre de /m/ a /a/ sin intentar retener vibración nasal a la fuerza.
Canta una palabra y luego una frase al mismo volumen cómodo.
stepsEn: Hum /m/ softly at a comfortable pitch.
Open from /m/ into /a/ without forcing nasal vibration.
Sing a word and then a phrase at the same comfortable loudness.
exercises.transferEs: Evalúa inteligibilidad y esfuerzo con tu profesor.
exercises.assessment: Subjective ease and intelligibility; no anatomical placement diagnosis.

exercises.goal: Coordinate sound onset, comfortable exhalation and vocal phrasing.
stepsEs: Suelta /s/ suave durante unos 4–6 s, sin perseguir máximos.
Descansa y canta /a/ en una altura cómoda durante 4–6 s.
Habla y canta una frase corta comparando comodidad.
stepsEn: Produce an easy /s/ for roughly 4–6 seconds without chasing a maximum.
Rest and sing /a/ at a comfortable pitch for 4–6 seconds.
Speak and sing a short phrase, comparing ease.
exercises.transferEs: Compara una frase, no la duración máxima de S.
exercises.assessment: Timer is sound/keyboard proxy, not respiratory pressure or support.
exercises.fallback: Space key measures button timing only; manual timing is acceptable.

exercises.goal: Match a reference pitch while permitting natural microvariation.
stepsEs: Escucha la nota completa, dentro de tu tesitura cómoda.
Canta /a/ suave durante 3–4 s, sin fijar la mandíbula ni la garganta.
Compara oído y gráfica, ignorando picos aislados del detector.
stepsEn: Listen to the whole note within your comfortable range.
Sing a soft /a/ for 3–4 seconds without fixing jaw or throat.
Compare listening with the trace; ignore isolated detector spikes.
exercises.transferEs: Canta la nota dentro de una frase real.
exercises.assessment: Pitch confidence and listening; not a vibrato diagnosis.
exercises.fallback: Use a reference instrument and recording with teacher if mic fails.

exercises.titleEs: Tres tomas: centro, vibrato libre, libre elección
exercises.titleEn: Three takes: centered, natural vibrato, unconstrained
exercises.goal: Differentiate intentional stylistic choices without forcing a straight tone.
stepsEs: Toma 1: mantén un centro cómodo durante 2–3 s, sin bloquear la garganta.
Toma 2: permite el vibrato que salga naturalmente; no pulses abdomen ni mandíbula.
Toma 3: repite sin consigna; escucha las tres a ciegas con tu profesor.
stepsEn: Take 1: sustain a comfortable pitch center 2–3 seconds without throat locking.
Take 2: allow natural vibrato; do not pump jaw or abdomen.
Take 3: sing without a constraint and compare blinded with your teacher.
exercises.transferEs: Repite el contraste en el final de una frase de la canción.
exercises.assessment: Teacher-audited choice/effort; never automatically grade vibrato as pathology.
exercises.fallback: Recordings optional; listen live when microphone is unavailable.

exercises.goal: Transfer ease to musical phrasing and intelligible text.
stepsEs: Marca una respiración natural al inicio de una frase breve.
Pronuncia la frase con intención y claridad.
Entónala y después cántala, sin subir la fuerza para compensar el volumen de pista.
stepsEn: Mark a natural breath in a short phrase.
Speak the phrase clearly with intention.
Intone, then sing it; do not push to compete with backing-track loudness.
exercises.transferEs: Pide evaluación A/B de claridad, esfuerzo e intención.
exercises.assessment: Blind perceptual comparison; not a clinical voice score.
exercises.fallback: Use teacher listening without automated pitch.

exercises.goal: Retain vocal ease under gentle stage movement.
stepsEs: Primera toma: frase cantada quieto, a volumen cómodo.
Segunda: añade un gesto sencillo y mirada al público sin contener el aire.
Tercera: compara ambas tomas, retirando movimientos si elevan el esfuerzo.
stepsEn: Take 1: sing a short phrase standing comfortably.
Take 2: add one small gesture and audience gaze without breath holding.
Take 3: compare and remove movement that increases effort.
exercises.transferEs: Usa una frase de tu actuación sin cubrirla con instrumental alto.
exercises.assessment: Teacher perceptual rating and self-rated effort.
exercises.fallback: Video optional; no microphone is needed.
